name: debugger
description: C64 Debugger — debugging remoto tramite VICE monitor, breakpoint, watchpoint, crash analysis

commands.name: attach
commands.label: Connetti a VICE
commands.description: Si connette al monitor remoto di VICE (x64sc)

commands.name: run
commands.label: Esegui PRG
commands.description: Avvia VICE headless con un PRG e si connette al monitor

commands.name: continue
commands.label: Continua
commands.description: Riprende l'esecuzione fino al prossimo breakpoint

commands.name: registers
commands.label: Registri
commands.description: Mostra lo stato dei registri CPU 6502

commands.name: crash-analyze
commands.label: Analisi crash
commands.description: Analizza un crash dump e diagnostica stack overflow/underflow o loop infiniti

commands.name: status
commands.label: Stato debugger
commands.description: Mostra lo stato della connessione a VICE
